rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans-serifs for headings.
Headings must have tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines/labels must be highly tracked (tracking-[0.2em]) and uppercase.
Rely heavily on Deep Palm Green and Crisp White for authoritative contrast.
Use Camel/Dark Brown accents for interactive states, borders, and warm highlights.
Never use pure black; use charcoal tinted with green (#1A211D) for dark text.
No purple or blue gradients. Use noise/grain textures instead of glossy gradients.

surfaces: Solid crisp backgrounds for marketing sections to maintain a clean editorial look.
Use 'Crystal Glass' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with 1px border-white/20) for sticky nav.
Admin dashboard should use 'Grid Borders' (border-collapse, 1px subtle border-border).
shadows: Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(11,59,36,0.06)]) for product cards.
Do not use heavy, muddy shadows.
borders: 1px delicate inner stroke to separate sections, using very subtle sand or green tint (border-[#EADDCA] or border-[#0B3B24]/10).
textures: Apply subtle grain/noise overlay on the hero or dark-green sections to kill digital flatness.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. Primary: bg-deep_palm_green text-white hover:bg-forest_shade transition-transform. Include hover lift (-translate-y-1).
components.inputs: Use Shadcn forms. Customize with 1px border-neutral-300, focus:ring-1 focus:ring-deep_palm_green focus:border-deep_palm_green.
components.cards: For product showcase, use clipped frames/spotlight treatment. Not generic standard cards. Use asymmetric image placements and sharp typographic hierarchy.
components.marquee: One slow editorial marquee for clients/certifications using react-fast-marquee. Serif or clean Mono, low contrast colors (e.g. pale green bg + dark green text), wide gap (gap-24).

marketing_pages: Use The Swiss Grid, overlapping elements, and aggressive asymmetry.
Use generous spacing: p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32.
Do NOT use standard Bootstrap columns. Avoid generic centered card grids.
admin_dashboard: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
No rounded corners on cards (sharp edges, cardless look). 1px subtle borders.

motion.hero_reveal: Kinetic Hero with masked line-by-line heading reveal using framer-motion (overflow-hidden on text lines, translateY from 100% to 0).
motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling momentum.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for subtle fade-up and parallax effects on images.
motion.parallax: One subtle parallax or 3D hero moment. Images moving at different speeds on scroll.

hero_and_landscape.description: Green fields and palm trees under a clear sky. Use for Hero or About page.

products.description: Coconuts on white surface. Treat deliberately with spotlight or clipped frames.
Brown coconut halves on wooden table.

logistics_and_export.description: Cargo ship. Great for logistics/export process section.
Green crops at sunset. Great for About section.

textures.description: Green textile abstract texture. Can be used for parallax/3D hero overlay.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against deep green or images meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio. Use drop-shadow or dark gradients behind text on images if necessary.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, and links MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='quote-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: BUILD A HYBRID APP: A high-end marketing site + Admin dashboard.
Do not use generic UI card grids for the marketing pages. Implement an asymmetric bento or overlapping editorial layout.

Implement the hero section with a bold heading: 'Bridging Borders, Building Opportunities: Bringing India's Finest Coconuts to the World'. Apply a masked line-by-line reveal animation using framer-motion.
Integrate a prominent 'Request Quote' sticky navigation.
Create a rich Customer Enquiry form with country code dropdown and multi-select product fields.
Create an Admin dashboard (leads table, status filter, update, CSV export). Use dense grid layouts and strict borders.
For the About page, use numbered manifesto chapters and an export process timeline.
Ensure the hero has a subtle scroll-based parallax effect.
universal_guidelines: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never apply universal transitions (e.g. transition: all). Add explicit transitions for specific properties.
Never center-align the main app container.
Always use modern button styles with hover feedback and right colors.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided media URLs.
All .js files must adhere to standard React component patterns with JSX (no TypeScript).
